Our Story

Built For The
Whole Table.

Dine Up opened its doors on Faizabad Road, Saidu Sharif, with one idea at the centre: a restaurant the whole family actually wants to go to. Big screens for match day, Wi-Fi for the ones who never log off, and a kids' menu so nobody's negotiating over fries.

Every corner is built the same way — peace, warmth, and a proper F&B experience — from our original branch to the newest one in Khwaza Khela.
